title: PatchKV: Efficient KV Cache Recovery for Dynamically Edited LLM Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2609.26219v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-running LLM agent workflows often revise interior context spans while retaining long suffixes. Although suffix tokens remain unchanged, altered causal histories and rotary positions prevent exact reuse of their offloaded key-value (KV) states. Full suffix recomputation wastes prefill work, while indiscriminate reuse propagates stale states and full-precision restoration adds data movement. We present PatchKV, a profile-guided recovery system for suffix-preserving revisions. PatchKV decomposes adjacent context versions into an exact prefix, an updated span, and an aligned suffix. It predicts an edit-local dirty region using an offline length-conditioned drift model, augments this region with sparse nonlocal blocks selected from stored attention, and block-rounds their union into a fixed repair set. The remaining suffix blocks are restored from CPU memory using frozen per-block precision tags and a fused path for dequantization, RoP

translated_title: PatchKV：面向动态编辑LLM上下文的高效KV缓存恢复
translated_abstract: 长时间运行的LLM智能体工作流经常在保留长后缀的同时修改内部的上下文片段。尽管后缀token本身保持不变，但改变的因果历史和旋转位置编码使得其已卸载的键值（KV）状态无法被精确复用。对整个后缀进行重新计算会浪费预填充的工作量，而不加区分地复用则会传播过时的状态，全精度恢复又会增加数据搬运开销。我们提出了PatchKV，一个面向保留后缀修订的、由剖析信息引导的恢复系统。PatchKV将相邻的上下文版本分解为精确前缀、更新片段和对齐后缀三部分。它利用一个离线的、以长度为条件的漂移模型来预测编辑局部的脏区域，并用从存储的注意力信息中选出的稀疏非局部块来扩充该区域，再将二者的并集按块取整为一个固定的修复集合。其余的后缀块则使用冻结的逐块精度标签以及一条融合了反量化与RoP（旋转位置编码重应用）的处理路径从CPU内存中恢复。
tldr: PatchKV通过将编辑前后的上下文分解为精确前缀、更新片段和对齐后缀，利用长度条件漂移模型预测编辑局部脏区域并结合稀疏非局部块进行定点修复，从而在动态编辑LLM上下文时高效恢复KV缓存，避免了完整后缀重计算与全精度恢复的开销。
en_tdlr: PatchKV enables efficient KV cache recovery for dynamically edited LLM contexts by decomposing revisions into an exact prefix, updated span, and aligned suffix, predicting edit-local dirty regions with a length-conditioned drift model, and repairing only a fixed block set to avoid full suffix recomputation and full-precision restoration overhead.
